arguments.summary: A credential compromise occurred on host WS-FIN-AP01 after a phishing campaign led to execution of a malicious PowerShell payload from Outlook. The payload deployed an unsigned DLL via rundll32.exe, establishing C2 communication over HTTPS to 198.51.100.23. Initial access was preceded by external reconnaissance from IP 185.220.101.42, which conducted an Nmap-style scan against internal asset WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15). Despite detection by EDR and network monitoring tools, no containment actions were approved during the Admin phase. A full EPP scan detected a low-severity PUP but missed the primary payload.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 conducted SYN scan against WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15), detected by IDS as 'ET SCAN Nmap SYN Scan'.
User CORP\jsmith launched Outlook on WS-FIN-AP01.
Malicious PowerShell process spawned from Outlook with encoded command (T1566.001).
rundll32.exe loaded unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
Established outbound C2 beacon over TCP/443 to 198.51.100.23 (T1071.001). Host file modification detected (T1565.001).
Incident detected and analyzed. Containment actions denied due to policy or evidence mismatch.
Full EPP scan completed on WS-FIN-AP01, identifying only a low-severity PUP.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Spawned from Outlook
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4688
conditions:
  - NewProcessName|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
  - ParentProcessName|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
  - CommandLine|contains: '-enc'
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/001/
description: Detects encoded PowerShell execution from Outlook, commonly seen in phishing payloads.

rule Suspicious_Rundll32_From_Temp {
    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32 loading DLLs from user temp directories"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $s1 = "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp" nocase
        $s2 = "rundll32.exe" nocase
        $s3 = ".dll" nocase
    condition:
        $s1 and $s2 and $s3
}
